title: pteridium aquilinum var. esculentum
intro: Pteridium aquilinum var. esculentum, commonly known as Bracken fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Pteridaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Bracken fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. Additionally, Bracken fern has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues.
